summary: An individual commenter filing as L.M. Marlowe submits a supplemental technical comment across the six show cause dockets, urging boundary telemetry, cost-causation allocation and a four-gate verification standard at the point of interconnection, and reserves rights in her framework.
ask: Consider continuous boundary telemetry and a four-gate verification standard in the large-load interconnection and cost-allocation methods, and note the commenter's reservation of intellectual property rights.

points.point: She argues reliability checks should move from periodic review to continuous validation at the interconnection boundary, since large computational loads change state in sub-cycle time.
points.quote: reliability verification should migrate from periodic review toward continuously operating validation performed at the interconnection boundary, sampled at sub-cycle resolution

points.point: Reliability burdens from large computational loads should be assigned to the loads that cause them, not to residential and small-commercial ratepayers.
points.quote: should be assigned to the loads that cause them, on a cost-causation basis, rather than socialized onto residential and small-commercial ratepayers.

points.point: She asks whether curtailment priority could place federally directed computational load ahead of ordinary large loads, citing DOE's 15-minute backup-generation curtailment of loads of 50 MW or more.
points.quote: directed curtailment of data centers and large loads of 50 MW or greater onto backup generation within fifteen minutes of an emergency signal

points.point: She proposes four verification gates at the point of common coupling: timing and stability, dependency map, throughput settlement, and certification.
points.quote: Such a standard would operate as a sequence of verification gates applied at interconnection, each addressing a specific consideration raised in this comment

points.point: The commenter reserves rights in a proprietary framework covered by pending patent applications.
points.quote: Commenter reserves all rights, including the right to seek appropriate relief in the proper forum.

throughLine.text: Comment filed in EL26-67 and the other show cause dockets; its cost-causation and observability proposals bear on the cost-shifting and transparency directives and curtailment questions raised by the June orders.
